meta.name: etetoolkit
meta.description: Analyze, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic or other hierarchical trees with ETE 4. Use for Newick/Nexus tree I/O, topology edits and pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree evolutionary events and reconciliation, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, SmartView exploration, and publication rendering. Do not use it to infer trees from raw sequences; align sequences and infer a tree first.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析、比较与注释进化树
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果处理系统发育数据并需要比较树结构。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze, compare, and annotate phylogenetic trees.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work with phylogenetic data and need to compare tree topologies.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude可以加载、编辑、比较和可视化系统发育树（Newick/NHX等格式），检测进化事件（复制/物种形成），获取NCBI分类信息，并生成出版级图片（PDF/SVG/PNG）。
howto.when: 当用户要求处理系统发育树文件（如.nw、.nhx）、进行树操作、比较或可视化时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取这个newick文件，显示树的基本信息。
say.note: 会加载树并输出叶节点数等统计。

say.text: 比较这两棵树的拓扑差异，计算RF距离。
对这个树进行中点生根并可视化输出PDF。
say.note: 会执行中点生根并渲染成PDF。

howto.what_en: Load, manipulate, compare, annotate, and visualize phylogenetic trees (Newick/NHX) with ETE 4. Supports topology edits, pattern matching, Robinson-Foulds comparisons, gene-tree event detection, NCBI/GTDB taxonomy, and publication-quality rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users request analysis or manipulation of phylogenetic tree files, tree comparison, visualization, or NCBI taxonomy integration.

say_en.text: Read this newick file and show basic tree info.
say_en.note: Will load tree and output leaf count etc.

say_en.text: Compare these two trees and compute RF distance.
Midpoint-root this tree and visualize as PDF.
say_en.note: Will perform midpoint rooting and render to PDF.
